protocol: User-corrected operational task: ignore harmless gravel; propose substantial raised rocks/bedrock blocks; explicitly identify rover equipment. Visually reviewed native PDS polygons, not independent expert truth or metric height labels. Unknown remains 255; boundary band excluded. Rover polygons take foreground occlusion precedence, without declaring the hidden ground free. Train episodes use old training acquisition groups or later dedicated training sols; validation/test episodes and physical scenes are separate. Sol71 excluded because it repeats the Sol82 rock cluster. Navigation must still confirm physical dimensions from actual stereo, never from apparent pixel size alone. Version2: manually reviewed ground ROIs and sky regions constrain full-image false positives. Listed substantial object polygons override ground; hardware overrides visible foreground occlusions. A 10-native-pixel uncertain collar around object/hardware boundaries remains ignored. Ambiguous regions stay unknown. This is not automatic filling of unreviewed scenes.
